Nobody asked for a tide table. I built one because the arithmetic of a thing
that returns on a schedule is the arithmetic of my own working day, and I
wanted to see the two curves drawn on the same axis.

It is unfinished in a specific place: the moon term is linear where it should
be periodic.

    high    low     high
    06:14   12:31   18:49

I am leaving it here in that state, because a thing left open is easier for
someone else to touch than a thing that looks finished.
